main:effect:203008.text: 死亡时，魅惑击杀它的生物3回合。
main:effect:203008.originalText: Upon dying, Charmed the creature that killed it for 3 turn.

main:effect:203010.name: 缠绕 5
main:effect:203010.text: 死亡时，魅惑击杀它的生物5回合。
main:effect:203010.originalText: Upon dying, Charmed the creature that killed it for 5 turn.

main:effect:203015.name: 缠绕 10
main:effect:203015.text: 死亡时，魅惑击杀它的生物10回合。
main:effect:203015.originalText: Upon dying, Charmed the creature that killed it for 10 turn.

main:effect:204001.name: 霜火水晶
main:effect:204001.text: 在战场上时，所有敌方生物被冻结，并且每回合受到3点冰霜伤害；若被点燃，此效果失效1回合。
main:effect:204001.originalText: While on the battlefield, all enemy creatures are Frozen and take 3 Frost damage each turn. If Ignited, this effect fails for 1 turn.

main:effect:205004.name: 载定命运
main:effect:205004.text: 受到伤害时，有50%概率将伤害降至0。免疫破甲。
main:effect:205004.originalText: When taking damage, 50% chance to reduce it to 0. Immune to Armor Break.

main:effect:206002.name: 烈焰领域 1
main:effect:206002.text: 行动时，对相邻格内的敌方生物造成1点火焰伤害。
main:effect:206002.originalText: When acting, deals 1 Fire damage to enemy creatures in adjacent squares.

main:effect:206003.name: 烈焰领域 2
main:effect:206003.text: 行动时，对相邻格内的敌方生物造成2点火焰伤害。
main:effect:206003.originalText: When acting, deals 2 Fire damage to enemy creatures in adjacent squares.

main:effect:206004.name: 烈焰领域 3
main:effect:206004.text: 行动时，对相邻格内的敌方生物造成3点火焰伤害。
main:effect:206004.originalText: When acting, deals 3 Fire damage to enemy creatures in adjacent squares.

main:effect:211001.name: 龙沉默
main:effect:211001.text: 召唤时，战场上的生物当前每受到1个光环或增益效果影响，便获得攻击力+1、生命值+2。
main:effect:211001.originalText: When summoned, gains +1 ATK and +2 HP for each Aura or buff currently affecting creatures on the battlefield.

main:effect:214001.name: 天界净化
main:effect:214001.text: 每回合随机驱散1个敌方生物的全部增益，并随机净化1个友方生物的全部减益；完成驱散或净化后，攻击力+2、生命值+2。
main:effect:214001.originalText: Each turn, randomly dispel all buffs from 1 enemy creature and randomly cleanse all debuffs from 1 friendly creature. After dispelling or cleansing, gain +2 ATK and +2 HP.

main:effect:220001.name: 扭转回溯时光
main:effect:220001.text: 此生物受到致命伤害时，有33%概率存活，并将生命值恢复至上回合结束时的数值。
main:effect:220001.originalText: If this creature takes lethal damage, it has a 33% chance to survive and return to the HP it had at the end of its previous turn.

main:effect:224001.name: 丘比特魅惑
main:effect:224001.text: 每回合随机魅惑1个攻击力最高的敌方生物1回合；被此效果魅惑的敌方生物造成伤害时，为天秤化身恢复等量生命值。
main:effect:224001.originalText: Each turn, randomly Charm 1 enemy creature with the highest ATK for 1 turn. When an enemy creature Charmed by this effect deals damage, heal Libra's Incarnation for the same amount.

main:effect:225001.name: 爱之回响
main:effect:225001.text: 召唤时，随机绑定1个非城墙敌方生物，使其代替此生物承受全部伤害；获得N点生命值，N等于绑定时该生物的生命值。
main:effect:225001.originalText: On summon, randomly bind 1 non-Wall enemy creature to take all damage dealt to this creature instead. Gain N HP, where N is the bound creature's HP when bound.

main:effect:229001.name: 灵魂毁灭
main:effect:229001.text: 进入战场时，随机引爆墓地中的1张敌方生物牌，并对所有敌方生物造成N点伤害，N等于被引爆牌的生命值；被引爆的牌移出对局。
main:effect:229001.originalText: When entering the battlefield, randomly detonates one enemy creature card in the Graveyard and deals N damage to all enemy creatures, where N equals the HP of the detonated card. The detonated card is removed from play.

main:effect:232001.name: 法力打击
main:effect:232001.text: 本次攻击前每受到1次法术伤害，便在本次攻击中获得攻击力+1；若共受到N次，则攻击力+N。
main:effect:232001.originalText: If it takes Magic damage N times before this attack, gains +N ATK for this attack.

main:effect:238001.name: 赤红暗焰之刃
main:effect:238001.text: 免疫扰乱和从手牌置入墓地的效果。友方神话品质暗焰之刃在战场上时，吸收它并合成为赤红暗焰之刃（6/8/28/暗焰斩/炎克/暗潮/永恒暗焰）。倒计时能力：在手牌中时，将墓地中的神话品质暗焰之刃放回牌库，最多1张。
main:effect:238001.originalText: Immune to Distraction and hand-to-grave. When a friendly Godlike Darkflame Blade is on the battlefield, absorbs it and combines into Blackflame Blade Red (6/8/28/Blackflame Slash/Flamebane/Dark Wave/Eternal Blackflame). Countdown ability. While in the Hand, revive Godlike Darkflame Blade from the Graveyard into the deck, max 1.

main:effect:243001.name: 死亡战锤
main:effect:243001.text: 死亡时，对击杀它的目标造成等于自身攻击力3倍的近战伤害。
main:effect:243001.originalText: Upon death, deals Melee damage equal to 3× its ATK to the target that killed it.

main:effect:247001.name: 妙手空空
main:effect:247001.text: 进入战场时，随机将敌方英雄牌库中的1张生物牌置入其召唤者手牌。
main:effect:247001.originalText: When entering the battlefield, randomly place 1 creature card from the enemy hero's deck into its summoner's Hand.

main:effect:255001.name: 战斗号令
main:effect:255001.text: 进入战场时，若场上敌方生物数不少于友方生物数，所有其他友方生物获得生命值+10和反击，持续3回合；若敌方生物数少于友方生物数，所有其他友方生物获得移动力+2、攻击力+3，持续3回合。
main:effect:255001.originalText: When entering the battlefield, if the no. of enemy creatures in play is greater than or equal to the no. of friendly creatures, all other friendly creatures gain +10 HP and Counterattack for 3 turns. If the no. of enemy creatures in play is less than the no. of friendly creatures, all other friendly creatures gain +2 Movement and +3 ATK for 3 turns.

main:effect:257001.name: 云掌
main:effect:257001.text: 受到伤害时，仅承受50%，其余50%由一个随机相邻敌方生物承受。
main:effect:257001.originalText: When taking damage, takes only 50% of the damage, while a random adjacent enemy creature takes the remaining 50% of the damage.

main:effect:390008.name: 暗影迷雾
main:effect:390008.text: 所有其他友方生物获得闪避：有50%概率将受到的物理伤害降至0。
main:effect:390008.originalText: All other friendly creatures gain Dodge: 50% chance to reduce Physical damage taken to 0.

main:effect:390023.name: 神圣衰朽
main:effect:390023.text: 在战场上时，所有敌方天使生物失去全部基础能力，受到双倍伤害，并且每回合受到3点暗影伤害。
main:effect:390023.originalText: While on the battlefield, all enemy Angel creatures lose all basic abilities, take double damage, and take 3 Shadow damage each turn

main:effect:390031.name: 冰霜精灵
main:effect:390031.text: 所有其他友方精灵获得霜缚1：每回合对一个随机敌方生物或英雄造成1点冰霜伤害。
main:effect:390031.originalText: All other friendly Elves gain status - Frostbound 1：Deals 1 Frost damage to a random enemy creature or Hero.

main:effect:390035.name: 幸运尾巴
main:effect:390035.text: 所有其他友方生物获得法力汲取：受到法术伤害时，将伤害降至0。
main:effect:390035.originalText: All other friendly creatures gain Mana Drain: When taking Magic damage, reduce the damage to 0.

main:effect:390037.name: 疲劳威压
main:effect:390037.text: 所有其他友方生物获得战斗疲劳1：敌方英雄每次抽牌时受到1点暗影伤害。
main:effect:390037.originalText: All other friendly creatures gain Battle Fatigue 1: Enemy hero takes 1 shadow damage each time when they draw a card.

main:effect:390038.name: 厄运
main:effect:390038.text: 所有敌方生物获得厄运：攻击力-2，并且每回合受到3点暗影伤害。
main:effect:390038.originalText: All enemy creatures gain status Doom: ATK-2, takes 3 shadow damage each turn.

main:effect:501001.name: 灵能涌动 1
main:effect:501001.text: 召唤时，己方宠物获得+1点攻击力，持续5回合。
main:effect:501001.originalText: When summoned, your Pets gain +1 ATK for 5 turns.

main:effect:501002.name: 灵能涌动 2
main:effect:501002.text: 召唤时，己方宠物获得+2点攻击力，持续5回合。
main:effect:501002.originalText: When summoned, your Pets gain +2 ATK for 5 turns.

main:effect:505004.name: 出发
main:effect:505004.text: 首回合获得最大移动力；移动时可穿过敌方生物；攻击后向后移动。
main:effect:505004.originalText: On first turn, gain maximum Movement. Can pass over enemy creatures when moving. Moves backward after attacking.

main:effect:505007.name: 群体致盲
main:effect:505007.text: 进场时，使所有敌方生物在1回合内无法攻击。
main:effect:505007.originalText: Upon entering the battlefield, all enemy creatures cannot attack for 1 turn.

main:effect:505011.name: 天穹之箭
main:effect:505011.text: 此生物首回合，对倒计时不高于4的生物造成伤害时，立即将其击杀。
main:effect:505011.originalText: On this creature's first turn, when it deals damage to a creature whose Countdown is 4 or less, kill it immediately.
